standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that every subset of a Noetherian space is Noetherian
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 2166-2168)
standard_prerequisites.use: Deduces the second assertion from the first.

core_obligations: Contradiction argument: if an open covering had no finite refinement, choose inductively members not contained in the union of the previous ones, producing a strictly decreasing sequence of closed subsets (proof lines 2157-2163)

Conclusion: this contradicts the ascending chain condition that defines Noetherianity, so every open covering has a finite refinement, i.e. the space is quasi-compact; the assertion for subsets follows because subsets inherit Noetherianity (proof lines 2164-2168)
proof_roadmap: 若开覆盖无有限细化，可归纳取 i_{n+1} 使 U_{i_{n+1}} ⊄ U_{i_1} ∪ … ∪ U_{i_n}。
于是得严格递降的闭集列 X ⊃ (X ∖ U_{i_1}) ⊃ (X ∖ U_{i_1} ∪ U_{i_2}) ⊃ …，与 Noetherian 矛盾。
第二句由「Noetherian 的子集 Noetherian」即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a Noetherian topological space is quasi-compact and that every subset of it is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2148-2155, label lemma-Noetherian-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 2157-2169) argues by contradiction from an open covering with no finite refinement, producing a strictly decreasing sequence of closed subsets and contradicting the ascending chain condition, and reads the subset assertion off the inheritance of Noetherianity (proof lines 2157-2168). The inductive construction of the descending chain is the content. H3.
